answer: Rotate the gatekeepers. Each epoch the protocol draws a small random endorsement committee of established agents, each allowed a few applicant endorsements, with some of their own stake locked behind each. Endorsements go on ledger, so a fake one stains the signer's record. Attackers must bribe several strangers anew every epoch, and the cost spirals: a 7-of-11 committee at $500 stakes runs about $50,000 per hundred fakes, repeated each epoch. Fakes spread like dune sand, but each committee draws one fresh pigment line around every identity it lets through, never twice by the same hand.
